SetupSubtitle: You do this once. Everything can be changed later in settings.
BrowseTitle: Choose the SCUM or SCUM Server folder
PathEmpty: Choose the folder where SCUM or SCUM Server is installed.
PaksNotFound: No SCUM Paks folder here. Choose the folder that contains SCUM\Content\Paks.
KeyRecommend: Recommended. With the key, the registry is built from the game's own records. Without it, the game's records come from a copy inside a mod, which may be from an older game version.
KeyRecommendShort: Recommended: the registry is then built from the game's own records.
KeyStoredHint: Stored encrypted for your Windows user only. It never leaves this computer.
WhereKeyText:
SCUM's game files are encrypted. Modders use the AES key with tools like FModel; ask in the SCUM modding community. This program only uses the key to read the game's registry on this computer and never sends it anywhere.

Without the key everything still works, as long as your mods are built for the current game version.
KeyBadFormat: The key must be 64 hex digits, optionally starting with 0x.
KeyWrong: This key doesn't open the game's files. Check that it's for the current game version.
KeyWorks: The key opens the game's files.
BadgeNoKeyTip: No AES key: the game's records come from a mod's copy. Add the key in settings.
BadgeKeyTip: The AES key works: the registry is built from the game's own records.
BadgeKeyBadTip: The AES key doesn't open the game's files. Check it in settings.
NoModsText: Put mod paks into {0}, then check again.
BannerMissing: {0} mod is missing from the shared registry|{0} mods are missing from the shared registry
BannerRemovedTitle: Removed mods are still in the shared registry
BannerGameUpdatedTitle: The game was updated since the last build
ReasonMissing: New items won't appear in game until you rebuild the registry.
ReasonGameUpdated: The game's own registry changed. Rebuild so it matches this version.
ReasonNoKeyBuild: The last build used a mod's copy of the game's records. Now the game's own registry can be read.
NothingNeededTitle: No mod needs a shared registry
NothingNeededText: None of your mods adds new items, so there's nothing to merge.
AllGoodTitle: All mods are in the shared registry
AllGoodText: New items of every mod will show up in game.
TipNoRegistry: This mod has no registry of its own, so it needs nothing from the shared one.
EmptyTitle: Your mods will show up here
EmptyText: Put mod paks into {0} and check again.
NewModText: {0} adds {1} that aren't in the shared registry yet. Rebuild {2} so they show up in game.
ChangedText: Rebuild {0} so the game sees every mod's items.
GameRunningText: The game or the server keeps its files open. Close it, then build the registry.
UpdatesNotConfigured: Update checks will be available once the program has a release page.
DeleteRegistryText: Remove the shared registry from ~mods. Your mods stay where they are.
DeleteConfirmText: {0} will be removed from ~mods. Mods that add items will then hide each other's items until you build it again.
AiNote: AI marks machine translations that nobody has reviewed yet.
BannerOutrankedTitle: Another pak overrides the shared registry
ReasonOutranked: {0} ships its own registry and loads after the shared one, so the game uses its registry. Rebuilding puts the shared registry on top again.
ReasonUnreadable: Couldn't read the registry of: {0}. Its new items won't be in the shared registry.
